name: lab-monitor
description: Home lab server monitoring and health check system. Manages servers with ping and SSH health checks. Use this for server status, uptime monitoring, and connectivity verification.

server_id.description: Server ID (numeric) - ONLY use if you have the numeric ID. For update-server, remove-server, query-server-status

server_name.description: Server name (e.g., 'yellowstone', 'glacier') - USE THIS when user mentions a server by name. For check-server, health-history

name.description: Server name - used for add-server only

ip.description: Server IP address - used for add-server

ssh_user.description: SSH username - used for add-server (default: current user)

notes.description: Server notes - used for add-server, update-server

status.description: Server status filter (online, offline, unknown) - used for list-servers

limit.description: Limit number of health check results - used for health-history (default: 10)
